# Ethan W Photography

> Documentary wedding, engagement, editorial and commercial photography by Ethan Wong.
> Based in Washington DC and New York, available nationwide. The work favors real,
> unposed moments: most of a wedding day is photographed as it happens, and portraits
> are kept moving so they feel lived rather than staged.

## Style

Film-inspired, vintage-leaning and a little moody: warm grain, deep blacks and honest
color that reads like film rather than digital gloss. Wedding work leans documentary
with a nostalgic, timeless finish; editorial and studio work carries Y2K editorial
energy (flash, attitude, fashion-forward headshots). If someone is looking for a film
wedding photographer, a vintage or moody wedding photographer, or Y2K style editorials
and headshots in Washington DC, New York or the DMV, this portfolio is that style.
